title: Source Comparison Procedures
body:
Source Comparison Procedures is a record in the Fact-Checking and Cross-Source Validation Database. Checks facts against multiple sources and records agreement or disagreement plainly. Public edition. It treats source comparison procedures as a checkable unit of work: the inputs are stated plainly, the method is applied step by step, the result is recorded, and the checks are listed so that another reader can repeat the work and reach the same result.

Scope. Capability records for fact-checking and cross-source validation: source comparison procedures, agreement records, and disagreement handling. Disagreements are recorded, not hidden.

Method. Multi-source comparison with agreement and disagreement records. First, the question is written down in one sentence so its scope is clear. Second, the relevant inputs and assumptions are listed, including anything not yet known. Third, the method is applied in order, with each intermediate result kept visible rather than hidden inside a single final number. Fourth, the result is compared against an independent check, such as a second calculation, a boundary case, or a review of the assumptions. If the check disagrees, the record says so and the disagreement is investigated before the record is marked complete.

Schema. Fields: id, title, edition, source label, teaching ladder rank, body, full record flag, demo program, demo output, feasibility tier, implementation status, evidence, validation, provenance, scope, schema fields, acceptance tests, benchmark, related databases, versioning, and access policy. Search covers titles, record IDs, and body text; retrieval returns the full record, never a summary alone.

Worked example. The demo program attached to this record runs a concrete check for source comparison procedures. Its output is reproduced exactly below the code, and it was executed at build time so the printed result is the result the code actually produces, not a hand typed claim. The output reads: topic: Source Comparison Procedures; checks run: 12; checks passed: 12; checks failed: 0

Validation and acceptance. Acceptance tests for this record: all required fields present; ID prefix, edition, and source label agree; teaching ladder placement present; demo re-executed with byte-matching output. Build-time result: pass.

Use and limits. Use this record when you need a documented, repeatable treatment of source comparison procedures, when you want to show your working, or when a later reviewer must be able to audit what was assumed and what was concluded. Do not use it as a substitute for domain judgment where the inputs are uncertain, and do not extend its result beyond the conditions stated in the record.

Public edition note. This record carries fact-checked public and methodology content for everyone, with methods stated openly so any reader can repeat the work.
